description: AGENTS.md and the README direct agents to query context, weigh severity, and treat attention items as decay signals
rationale: Agents must discover and honor intent at the moment they decide, from the repository alone, without a second copy that could drift.
requirements: The protocol tells agents to run context before changing a path and to weigh intent by severity
The protocol states that the presence of intent is not a violation and that compliant changes should be approved
The protocol treats status attention items as decay signals rather than current constraints
title: Agent protocol uses the in-repo query surface
